sv.title: Död häst hittad i container: ”Blir äcklad”
sv.summary: Nyligen deltog hästen So You Are i prestigefyllda Melbourne Cup. Nu har den hittats död i en container i Sydney. Fallet väcker ilska och ska nu utredas.

en.title: Dead horse found in container: "Getting disgusted"
en.summary: The horse So You Are recently took part in the prestigious Melbourne Cup. Now it has been found dead in a container in Sydney. The case is causing anger and will now be investigated.
